profile.headline: Front-End Software Engineer
profile.summary: Highly qualified, detail oriented Front-End Software Engineer with extensive experience in the full development life-cycle of websites from initial design through development and maintenance. Results-driven with a demonstrated ability to lead successful replatforming projects and deliver exceptional user experiences with a strong focus on web accessibility and responsive design.
